name: Pedro Mendoza
hero: DevOps Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer passionate about automation, reliability, and the scalability of modern platforms. With more than 5 years of experience designing, operating, and optimizing hybrid and cloud-native infrastructure, I help organizations accelerate delivery cycles through DevOps practices, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code. My focus is building resilient, observable systems that are ready to grow with the needs of the business.
about: Hi, I'm Pedro Mendoza. I was born in Venezuela, graduated as a Computer Engineer from the Universidad Nacional Experimental del Tachira, and currently live in Uruguay.

Throughout my career I have found in technology a strong mix of curiosity, continuous learning, and problem solving. I enjoy understanding how things work behind the scenes, building useful solutions, and simplifying complex processes through automation.

Beyond production environments and infrastructure, I enjoy exploring new tools, learning constantly, and sharing knowledge with other professionals. I believe the best solutions come from the combination of technical excellence, collaboration, and genuine curiosity to improve every day.
